customer: University labs, electronics/repair benches, small NPI/test teams and workshop operators needing a dedicated touchscreen console with abundant legacy serial/USB connectivity and a reproducible hardware-test workflow.
position: A remanufactured lab/bench console built from an exact-qualified retired POS terminal plus a new low-voltage Hardware-Splicer sidecar; positioned below new industrial panel PCs without claiming industrial certification or equivalent environmental ratings.

economics.note: Screening targets only. Donor price, measured yield, sidecar BOM and warranty cost are not yet supplier/production evidence.

approved_donor.reason: The B91 manual documents SATA storage, 10/100/1000 LAN, up to 4 GB DDR2, four rear powered COM ports, six external USB ports and Linux OS support. B81 is not interchangeable for PF-002.

current_market_observation.note: One public listing is not lot-depth evidence.

retained_capabilities: 12.1-inch resistive touchscreen and tilting operator enclosure
B91 compute board and memory if acceptance tests pass
four documented rear powered COM ports
intact internal power architecture with no PSU modification
replaced_or_serviced: storage replaced by known-good SATA SSD
CMOS battery replaced when measured below acceptance threshold
external power cord replaced if condition is uncertain
cooling/thermal interface serviced only under documented donor procedure

software.role: lightweight operator terminal and device gateway, not local heavy AI compute
software.candidate_image: Debian-class lightweight Linux image with kiosk/web console, local serial/USB proxy and HS evidence agent
requirements_before_release: touch input works after cold boot
all retained COM ports pass loopback/known-device tests
exact OS image hash is recorded
finished-unit donor serial/revision + sidecar revision + image hash are bound in QA receipt

explicit_non_goals: replacement/equivalence claim for Advantech industrial panel PCs
opening or modifying the donor ATX power supply
next_gate: First close donor identity/yield on a bounded POS462/B91 sample. Before scaling beyond a prototype/micro-pilot, obtain direct buyer evidence at or near NT$8,990 for the complete BenchHMI + BenchIO appliance; competitor listings alone do not validate the price.
